datasets.title: IGAD Region - Dekadal Combined Drought Indicator(CDI) 2022
datasets.description: Dekadal(10days) Combined Drought Indicator (CDI) as implemented in the East Africa Drought Watch, and which is used for detecting and monitoring areas that either are affected or have the potential to be affected by meteorological, agricultural and/or hydrological drought.. [Source: This metadata record was automatically extracted from the Humanitarian Data Exchange (HDX); Original dataset: https://data.humdata.org/dataset/igad-region-dekadal-combined-drought-indicator-cdi-2022]

contact_point.name: IGAD Climate Prediction and Applications Center (ICPAC)

creator.name: IGAD Climate Prediction and Applications Center (ICPAC)

lineage.description: Dekadal CDI rasters were generated by ICPAC using the East Africa Drought Watch methodology, which combines multiple drought indicators (meteorological, agricultural, hydrological) into a composite index to detect and monitor drought-affected areas across the IGAD region. The 36 GeoTIFF files represent consecutive 10-day periods throughout 2022, providing temporal monitoring of drought conditions.

sources.name: IGAD Climate Prediction and Applications Center (ICPAC)
sources.description: East Africa Drought Watch Combined Drought Indicator (CDI) methodology that integrates meteorological, agricultural, and hydrological drought indicators into a composite dekadal monitoring product
